notes.title: Update 0.748
notes.notes:
Changes:

New mode "Local Battle". You can play on one PC, using a keyboard or game controllers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393109/d522009d3cfd01aa3c194d3038e3a7d60c56dd10.gif


In this mode, there are two local profiles with their own motions and skins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393109/d7abc558bf5c32d315389dd951e341d2e572e4e0.gif


If you are playing with two gamepads, then select the option in the settings: "Gamepad + Gamepad". By default, the first player uses the keyboard and the second player uses the gamepad.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393109/282bfb6ca8c9a43d13ee63396bff32f7f6fd43ec.gif


In the settings, you can change the key bindings.


Fixes:

Saving the selected skin is now stable.

notes.title: Update 0.722
notes.notes:
Changes

Bot activation in training mode. The bot will use the player's movements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393109/23872e571f59c24e106ca7f75cea7a8e84061f2e.gif


Automatic assignment of created animations to buttons 0-9

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41393109/6920414a4ef913b2f532cd3fe6f806d5b940d109.gif


In ranked mode, after 30 seconds of waiting, the game will start with a bot. The bot's rating will be similar to the player's rating. The fight will affect the rating.

Plans
Сampaign

Local battles together on one computer

notes.title: Update 0.688
